# Ticketing Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard gives Template support leaders a real-time view of queue health, ticket aging, and service performance. It supports IT, HR, facilities, and customer support teams in spotting SLA breaches, reopens, and backlog spikes before they escalate.

## Key Metrics
- New Tickets: 8
- Closed Tickets: 75
- Reopened Tickets: 3
- On Hold: 16
- SLA Compliance: 94%
- Average Resolution Time: 1d 4h

## Insights
- IT queue carries the largest ticket load; Medical is the highest-priority by aging
- Reopen rate is stable at ~2%, within the acceptable quality target
- Resolution time trending slightly up — driven by urgent SSO and integration tickets
